persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalla
persons.evidence: śrīśrī jayabhūpatīndramallamahārājādhirājasana vīrasiddhipyākhana lāja ṅūtakā yāva dayakā

date.as_written: saṃvat 820 aṇṭa āśvina vadi 10 puṣyanakṣatra bṛhaspativāra

notes: The manuscript records two dates for ceremonies/performances related to the Vīrasiddhi: the first under King Bhūpatīndra Malla in NS 820 (1700 CE), and an additional ritual entry under his son King Raṇajit Malla dated saṃ 841 phālguṇa sudi 4 (1721 CE).
